summary.text: Sylleste Davis is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 100 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
She assumed office on June 13, 2016, and faces Democrat Crystal Campbell in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Sylleste Davis holds a bachelor's degree from the College of Charleston and a graduate degree from Webster University, according to Ballotpedia.
She assumed office in the South Carolina House of Representatives on June 13, 2016, and her current term ends on November 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her as chairman of the Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee for 2023-2024 and as a member of that committee for 2025-2026.
